_comment: Repository cleanup automation - add to hooks config

preToolUse.description: Warn about files in wrong locations
preToolUse.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ]; then if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qE "^[^/]+\.(png|jpg|gif|md|txt)$"; then echo "⚠️ Creating file at repository root"; echo "Consider: docs/images/ for images, docs/ for documentation"; fi; fi'
echo "💡 Moving image file. Remember: docs/images/ for documentation screenshots"

postToolUse.description: Remind to link new docs from CLAUDE.md or README
postToolUse.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ]; then echo "💡 New doc created: $FILE_PATH"; echo "Remember to link from CLAUDE.md or README.md if important"; fi'
bash -c 'if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ]; then echo "💡 New script created"; echo "Remember to:"; echo "  1. Add purpose comment at top of script"; echo "  2. Document in scripts/README.md"; fi'

sessionEnd.description: Check for temporary files before ending
sessionEnd.command: bash -c 'TEMP_FILES=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name "*.png" -o -name "*.jpg" -o -name "*test*" -o -name "*temp*" -o -name "*tmp*" \) 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$TEMP_FILES" -gt 0 ]; then echo "⚠️ Temporary files detected at root:"; find . -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name "*.png" -o -name "*.jpg" -o -name "*test*" -o -name "*temp*" -o -name "*tmp*" \); echo "Delete or relocate before ending session?"; fi'
